title: Use More Threads, Not Fewer: Thread Scaling for LLM Decode on Hybrid and Homogeneous Edge CPUs
description: Measurement artifact for a manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems. LLM decode thread scaling on an Intel i7-12700H (hybrid Golden Cove plus Gracemont cores) and a Raspberry Pi 5 (Cortex-A76). Capping threads at the performance-core count costs 18.5% of decode throughput on the i7-12700H, where throughput peaks at 16 threads. Past the peak the cost is predictability rather than speed: the coefficient of variation rises from 2.7% at 16 threads to 29.4% at 18, and a controlled headroom experiment names the cause. Includes the raw records, the analysis code, and the macros the manuscript compiles from.
